question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Bewilderment
solution:
The correct answer is **"Confusion."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Bewilderment"** means a state of confusion or puzzlement. (घबराहट, संभ्रम, हैरानगी)

 
 
• **Example: ***As he walked through the door, she stared at him in utter **bewilderment**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Confusion"** means a lack of understanding or uncertainty. (उलझन, घबराहट, भ्रम, किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ता)
 __
 
• **Example:** *She looked at the complex math problem with **confusion**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Confusion"** is a synonym for "**bewilderment."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Agreement: **a state of harmony or accord
 
• **Arrangement: **a plan or organization
 
• **Settlement:** an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute
